import os, stat
root = "/app/submission"
print("root isdir:", os.path.isdir(root), "islink:", os.path.islink(root))
bad = []
total = 0
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
    for name in dirnames:
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
        st = os.lstat(p)
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
            bad.append(("nondir in dirnames", p))
    for name in filenames:
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
        st = os.lstat(p)
        total += st.st_size
        if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
            bad.append(("symlink", p))
        elif not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            bad.append(("not regular", p, stat.filemode(st.st_mode)))
        elif st.st_nlink != 1:
            bad.append(("nlink!=1", p, st.st_nlink))
        print("  %-40s mode=%s nlink=%d size=%d" % (p, stat.filemode(st.st_mode), st.st_nlink, st.st_size))
print("entries ok" if not bad else ("PROBLEMS: %s" % bad))
print("total bytes:", total)
PYEOF
